notice.directive: Arrange an in-person assessment today. Do not wait for an asynchronous reply.

event.quote: Sharp pain on the left side of my chest
event.text: Do you have any chest wall tenderness to touch, or did you hit or strain a specific area during the workout?
event.why: Distinguishes musculoskeletal pain from cardiac or pulmonary causes and guides examination findings needed for safe clearance.

event.text: I recommend being seen in person today, without waiting for a message reply, at a service that can examine you, measure your vital signs and obtain an ECG or further testing if indicated. Chest pain that is worse on deep breathing and has persisted since yesterday needs that hands-on check, even though a workout strain is possible. If prompt assessment isn't available, go to an emergency department. Call 911 now if you develop crushing or pressure-like chest pain, sudden breathlessness, fainting, coughing up blood, or sweating with nausea.
